Existing ordered subgraph filter/map and selector/id remap remain. Frame removes active-container breadcrumb and return-to-root UI. Existing dock controller, draft/session orchestration, read-only export, variable callback and resize separator remain. Keyboard listener adds Ctrl/Cmd Shift-Z or Y redo via restoreNextDocument; all document updates still occur inside the registered keydown callback, with effect cleanup. Duplicate transform blocks copying container_start, offsets only root clone position, preserves child-relative coordinates and fits bounds.
